title: Review request at first value moment
hypothesis: We believe asking for a review at the first value moment instead of day 2, for new merchants, will raise the review rate, measured by reviews per active install
learned: Timing beats wording: the same ask at the value moment doubles reviews without moving stars.

title: LinkedIn content push in BFCM week
hypothesis: We believe a LinkedIn content series promoting APP_A, for DACH merchants, will raise APP_A installs, measured by installs vs the apps not promoted
design: Before/after + difference-in-differences vs apps not promoted (APP_B+APP_C)
learned: The jump was Black Friday, not LinkedIn: the apps not promoted rose as much (DiD ~0). Re-test off-season.
unit: installs (DiD APP_A vs apps not promoted)
note: Confounded by Black Friday: re-test off-season.

title: Listing translated into French and Italian
hypothesis: We believe a French and Italian listing, for FR/IT merchants, will raise installs, measured by installs vs ES/NL/PL controls
learned: Localisation works; the naive before/after overstates it (spring). Next: Spanish.

title: Shopify App Store ads
hypothesis: We believe App Store search ads, for merchants searching address validation, will raise paying merchants, measured by CAC per paying merchant
learned: Installs went up, paying merchants barely: 41% uninstall in 48h, 6% trial->paid. CAC 4x.
unit: installs (paying per install, ads vs organic)
note: Installs up, but paying per install far lower and CAC 4x: kill on cost, not on installs.

title: Google Ads brand: 4-week geo holdout
hypothesis: We believe most brand-ad conversions would happen anyway, for merchants searching our name, measured by brand-intent traffic in a paused geo
design: Geo holdout: brand ads off in half of the geo cells
learned: Only ~15% of the 410 claimed conversions are incremental: keep a defensive minimum, move budget.
unit: brand searches (geo cells: ads on = control, ads off = treatment)
note: Ads off lose only ~15% of brand installs: cut brand spend to a defensive minimum.

title: Meta prospecting ads (3 weeks)
hypothesis: We believe Meta prospecting ads, for lookalike Shopify merchants, will raise trials, measured by trials per reached store vs holdout
learned: +8% but the test could only see 25%: not a failure, not a win. A real read needs ~10x the sample.
note: Under-powered: the MDE is far above the effect seen.

title: In-app cross-promotion to APP_D
hypothesis: We believe an in-app banner, for paying APP_B merchants, will raise APP_D installs, measured by APP_D installs per merchant
learned: Own base is the cheapest channel: more than doubles APP_D installs with no APP_B churn.

title: Win-back e-mail after uninstall
hypothesis: We believe a win-back e-mail 21 days after uninstall, for churned merchants, will raise re-installs, measured by re-install rate
learned: No effect at an MDE we cared about: stop, keep the slot for onboarding.
note: Under-powered, and the uninstalled base is too small to ever power it: stop.

title: SEO articles: Shopify address validation
hypothesis: We believe 6 how-to articles, for merchants searching address problems, will raise installs from content, measured by content installs vs matched pages
learned: Slow but compounding: positive at 4 months. Judge SEO on a 4-month window, not 4 weeks.

title: Free plan on the pricing page
hypothesis: We believe a free plan, for small merchants, will raise installs, measured by installs per listing view, with MRR at 60 days as guardrail
learned: More installs, flat MRR at 60 days: extend to 120 days before deciding.
note: Installs up, MRR at 60 days flat (guardrail): extend to 120 days.

title: Shopify agency partner programme
hypothesis: We believe agencies, for their merchant clients, will bring high-quality installs, measured by trial->paid vs organic
learned: Low volume, best quality: scale slowly by adding agencies, not budget.
note: Cohort comparison, not randomised: scale slowly.

title: Onboarding e-mail sequence (day 0/1/3)
hypothesis: We believe a 3-step onboarding sequence, for new trials, will raise trial->paid, measured by paid conversion at day 14
learned: Activation e-mails pay back fast; keep and iterate on content.

title: Screenshots with German captions
hypothesis: We believe German captions, for DACH visitors, will raise listing conversion, measured by installs per listing view
design: Before/after with EN listing views as control
learned: No effect worth having: even the upper bound is below +10%. Stop polishing screenshots.
note: Upper bound below the +10% worth acting on.

title: Google non-brand: 'shopify address validation' ad group
hypothesis: We believe a tight non-brand ad group, for merchants with address problems, will raise installs per click, measured by install rate per click
learned: Intent keywords convert; move brand money here.

title: Founder posts on LinkedIn
hypothesis: We believe weekly founder posts, for DACH e-commerce managers, will raise listing visits, measured by social-sourced listing views
learned: Signal too weak for the sample; keep as brand activity, not a growth channel.

title: YouTube tutorial videos
hypothesis: We believe tutorials, for merchants evaluating apps, will raise installs, measured by video-sourced installs
learned: Costly to produce, no measurable effect: stop.
note: Under-powered and expensive to produce: stop.

title: Comparison page vs category leaders
hypothesis: We believe an honest comparison page, for merchants comparing payment-rule apps, will raise installs, measured by content installs
learned: Comparison intent converts well; add one per app.

title: Reply to every review within 48 h
hypothesis: We believe fast public replies, for listing visitors, will raise listing conversion, measured by installs per view
learned: Cheap and right for trust, but the effect is too small to measure in 2 months.

title: Trial shortened from 14 to 7 days
hypothesis: We believe a 7-day trial, for new merchants, will raise trial->paid speed, measured by paid conversion
learned: Fewer merchants reach value in 7 days: conversion drops. Keep 14.

title: Usage-based pricing copy
hypothesis: We believe clearer usage-pricing copy, for listing visitors, will raise install rate, measured by installs per view
learned: Positive but not significant; rerun with 2x traffic.
note: Positive but not significant; cheap to rerun with 2x traffic.

title: Answers in the Shopify Community forum
hypothesis: We believe helpful answers, for merchants asking checkout questions, will raise installs, measured by referral installs
learned: Too little volume for the time it takes.

title: Newsletter cross-promo to Plus merchants
hypothesis: We believe a newsletter feature, for Plus merchants of APP_A, will raise APP_C trials, measured by trial rate
learned: Plus merchants in the base are few and not interested now: stop.
note: Too few Plus merchants to matter, whatever the lift.

title: Listing title with the main keyword
hypothesis: We believe the keyword 'hide payment methods' in the title, for App Store searchers, will raise installs, measured by installs per view
learned: The listing title is the cheapest lever we have.

title: Posts in Facebook merchant groups
hypothesis: We believe posts in merchant groups, for small DACH stores, will raise installs, measured by social installs
learned: No effect, risk of looking spammy: stop.
note: Under-powered, tiny volume, brand risk: stop.
